let S₂ := Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)
let S₄ := Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)
let G := S₄ × S₄
let split : S₂ × S₂ →* S₄ :=
  MonoidHom.comp
    (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (Equiv.permCongrHom (finSumFinEquiv (m := 2) (n := 2))))
    (Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom (Fin 2) (Fin 2))
let P : Subgroup S₄ := MonoidHom.range split
let T : Subgroup S₄ := ⊤
let K : Subgroup G := Subgroup.prod P T
let H : Subgroup G := Subgroup.prod T P
(∀ q : DoubleCoset.Quotient (P : Set S₄) (T : Set S₄),
  q = DoubleCoset.mk P T (1 : S₄)) ∧
(∀ q : DoubleCoset.Quotient (T : Set S₄) (P : Set S₄),
  q = DoubleCoset.mk T P (1 : S₄)) ∧
(∀ q : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G),
  q = DoubleCoset.mk K H (1 : G)) ∧
K ⊓ H = Subgroup.prod P P ∧
Nonempty (↥(K ⊓ H) ≃* ((S₂ × S₂) × (S₂ × S₂)))
